category: Search eligibility, technical requirements, spam policies
conclusion: Eligible search presence requires technical accessibility, non-spam behavior, crawlable links, and helpful content.
Content should primarily help people and demonstrate clear value, not search-engine-first production.
Sitemaps identify important canonical URLs but do not guarantee crawling or indexing.
Noindex must be discoverable through crawling; robots blocking can prevent Google from seeing noindex.
Use absolute self-referencing canonicals and link internally to canonical URLs.
JSON-LD should describe visible page content and avoid misleading or hidden claims.

source_title: Make sure your site's pages are ready for AdSense
conclusion: Pages need clear navigation and unique, original, relevant content.
Publishers must follow AdSense and Google Publisher policies.
Accessibility requires perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust content verified by automated and human methods.
Core Web Vitals should separate lab and field evidence; no field data was available in this audit.
Cloudflare Workers Static Assets serves the built static asset directory configured in Wrangler.
Schema.org vocabulary supports type-level semantic review separate from Google rich result eligibility.
